basis: 最新のリポジトリ内本番RLS適用記録を再現した隔離DB + 0040。本番との一致は別途検査し、不一致なら停止する。

triggers.trigger: CREATE TRIGGER fixed_pair_event_finish BEFORE UPDATE OF status, stats_mode ON public.events FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION fixed_pair_private.guard_legacy_write()
CREATE TRIGGER guard_event_identity BEFORE UPDATE ON public.events FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION events_identity_private.guard_event_identity()
CREATE TRIGGER guard_event_member_fields BEFORE UPDATE ON public.events FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION events_operation_private.guard_member_fields()
CREATE TRIGGER guard_participant_identity BEFORE UPDATE ON public.event_participants FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION participants_identity_private.guard_identity()

CREATE TRIGGER profile_link_participant_reference BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF player_profile_id, profile_id ON public.event_participants FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION profile_link_private.guard_reference('player_profile_id')
CREATE TRIGGER fixed_pair_round_create BEFORE INSERT ON public.rounds FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION fixed_pair_private.guard_legacy_write()
CREATE TRIGGER guard_match_identity BEFORE UPDATE ON public.rounds FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION match_identity_private.guard_identity('id', 'event_id')
CREATE TRIGGER fixed_pair_match_create BEFORE INSERT ON public.matches FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION fixed_pair_private.guard_legacy_write()
CREATE TRIGGER guard_match_identity BEFORE UPDATE ON public.matches FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION match_identity_private.guard_identity('id', 'event_id', 'round_id')
CREATE TRIGGER fixed_pair_lineup BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF team ON public.match_players FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION fixed_pair_private.guard_legacy_write()
CREATE TRIGGER guard_match_identity BEFORE UPDATE ON public.match_players FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION match_identity_private.guard_identity('id', 'match_id', 'participant_id')
CREATE TRIGGER guard_match_identity BEFORE UPDATE ON public.match_results FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION match_identity_private.guard_identity('id', 'match_id')
